episodes.title: Introduction to Cognitive Bias
episodes.description: Recognize how biased thinking shapes perception and how scientific methods can challenge it.

episodes.title: Statistical Thinking in Science
episodes.description: Use statistics to interpret everyday claims, assess uncertainty, and make better-informed judgments.

episodes.title: How Does Science Really Work? The Myth of the Great Experiment
episodes.description: Look beyond the lone-genius story to understand experiments, collaboration, and difficult study design.

episodes.title: Peer Review and the Quest for Truth
episodes.description: Explore peer review as a way for science to examine and correct its own claims.

episodes.title: How Scientists Build Consensus
episodes.description: Understand how researchers reach agreement while uncertainty remains within well-studied topics.

episodes.title: Evaluating Sources & Fact Checking
episodes.description: Practice evaluating sources and checking scientific claims before accepting media coverage.

episodes.title: What Happens When Science Clashes with the Public?
episodes.description: Explore conflicts between research findings, public attitudes, personal values, and corporate interests.
